title_zh: 删除未经证实的纯水说明并保留冻结观察

scenario.label_zh: 限定冻结实验记录中的材料断言
scenario.goal_zh: 发现未核实水的纯度，决定记录实际容器标签和冻结现象而不声称是纯水实验

context_zh: 学生查看老师提供的冻结演示记录。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I've described this as a test using pure water. Do we know that's what was in the bottle?

sentences.speaker: Seren
sentences.text: The label just says tap water. We didn't measure what else was in it.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Then I can't use the result to make a precise claim about pure water.

sentences.speaker: Seren
sentences.text: No. We can describe the phenomenon we observed: ice formed first around the edge.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: I'll keep that observation and replace the material description with what the label actually says.

sentences.speaker: Seren
sentences.text: And add that we didn't check the contents independently. That makes the limit clear.
